handlers.name: ActorType18_19_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Shared interaction/response family. Ungated contacts route through Player_ProcessInteractionState. Type 0x19 has an additional interaction-lock/sound branch. The proximity path installs a type-0x84 response state with animation 0x001248B6; the terminal path clears/reinitializes through ACTOR_TEMPLATE_COLLISION_TYPE_84 and publishes the response counter/event path.

handlers.name: ActorType32_79_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Three-gate interaction check followed by TERRAIN_RESPONSE_TIMER_STATE clear and Player_ProcessInteractionState; otherwise no response writes.

handlers.name: ActorType7D_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: CAMERA_SPECIAL_MODE selects the player terrain-response animation and interaction-pending latch. The non-special path arms PLAYER_TERMINAL_TRANSITION and falls through to the type-0x78/0x7A proximity body at 0x001AEBDC.

handlers.name: ActorType78_7A_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Direct interaction-state recovery when ungated; otherwise a bounded actor/player X proximity check before Player_ProcessInteractionState.

boundary_checks.fallthrough_bytes: 0x001AEBA4-0x001AEBDB are an entry-specific prefix whose non-special branch falls through to the separately named 0x001AEBDC shared tail.
boundary_checks.padding: 0x001AEB7A-0x001AEB7B remains the two-byte gap between the type-0x18/0x19 body and the type-0x32/0x79 entry.
boundary_checks.result: The table entries and the type-0x7D shared-tail relationship are explicit without assigning the fall-through prefix a false independent range.

conclusion: The broad Ghidra multi-entry region is now split into four canonical dispatch identities: a type-0x18/0x19 interaction response, a type-0x32/0x79 timer-clearing recovery, a type-0x7D special-camera/terminal prefix, and a type-0x78/0x7A proximity response. These are interaction and presentation handlers, not the missing Level 01 vertical transfer writer.
